stem:
A survey was conducted in the school. Student using different modes of transport is given below:

| Mode of Transport | Percentage of Students |
|---|---|
| Bicycle | 35 |
| Bus | \(a\) |
| Railway | \(2a\) |
| Rickshaw | 20 |

Find the value of \(a\) and draw the Pie diagram.
solution: The percentages total \(100\): \(35 + a + 2a + 20 = 100\), so \(3a + 55 = 100\), giving \(3a = 45\) and \(a = 15\). Hence Bus \(= 15\%\) and Railway \(= 2a = 30\%\). The measure of the central angle for each mode \(= \dfrac{\text{percentage}}{100}\times 360^\circ\): Bicycle \(= \dfrac{35}{100}\times 360^\circ = 126^\circ\); Bus \(= \dfrac{15}{100}\times 360^\circ = 54^\circ\); Railway \(= \dfrac{30}{100}\times 360^\circ = 108^\circ\); Rickshaw \(= \dfrac{20}{100}\times 360^\circ = 72^\circ\). Draw a circle and mark sectors of these central angles to obtain the required pie diagram.

stem: There are some students in group A and group B. If one student goes from group A to group B, then the number of students in both groups is same. But if one student goes from group B to group A, then the number of students in group A becomes twice of group B. Find the number of students in each group.
solution: Let group A have \(x\) students and group B have \(y\) students. If one goes A to B: \(x - 1 = y + 1\), so \(x - y = 2\) ... (i). If one goes B to A: \(x + 1 = 2(y - 1)\), so \(x + 1 = 2y - 2\), giving \(x - 2y = -3\) ... (ii). Subtract (ii) from (i): \((x - y) - (x - 2y) = 2 - (-3)\), so \(y = 5\). Then from (i), \(x = 7\). Group A has 7 students and group B has 5 students.
